objective: Retire an obsolete Organization Setup R24 auto-dispatch that attempted an unsupported direct web workflow_dispatch on every organization source change; preserve explicit reviewed publication only.
productionBaselineEvidence: Main exact SHA 538f94d0305548ebe94425fded526bca7c02d048 merged source-only ad lock and produced R24 Dispatch run 42972951187 failure: 422 workflow lacks workflow_dispatch; production_android_ota and production_web_deploy skipped at same SHA.
chosenApproach: Remove the push-triggered automatic production web dispatch and all actions:write permission; retain a manual no-op explanatory legacy job while protecting canonical source-marker publisher.
selectionRationale: New protected production_web_deploy.yml deliberately has push-only release markers. Legacy R24 automatically invokes a nonexistent workflow_dispatch and creates false failed runs; restoring dispatch would bypass release gates.
alternativeApproaches: Re-enable production web manual dispatch (rejected: bypasses release-marker gates).
Retire only legacy indirect publisher and add focused anti-regression test (chosen).
acceptanceChecks: No automatic push trigger on retired R24 workflow
No actions write or gh workflow run production web dispatch
Existing canonical Android and Web production release marker checks remain untouched
PR source and CI pass; no OTA/web deployment triggered by source merge
preserveBehaviors: No changes to BUKLOD Main runtime screens, ads, organization hierarchy or database
Canonical explicit main production release contract preserved
No direct or accidental web/OTA dispatch
